tutorial.brief.title: Drive and Shoot
tutorial.brief.drive: Push the left joystick where you want the nose to point: the chariot turns that way and drives there, further for faster, and coasts when you let go. Held still, a small push back past the tail reverses slowly. A palisade costs hull.
tutorial.brief.fire: Tap "Fire / Hit" at the lower right to loose a bolt with aim assist; keep it held for the full draw and release to shoot - the longer the draw, the further the bolt.
tutorial.tactics.title: Line, Bows and Chariot
tutorial.tactics.infantry: The infantry hold their posts and step up only when you close in - but four or five bodies within reach counter-attack together. Do not park in the middle of them: hit the front at speed and open a gap.
tutorial.tactics.archers: The archers behind the line shoot at the horses, so the longer you circle the more arrows fall. They fear the press: close in and they back off to shoot, and right on top of them they cannot loose at all.
tutorial.tactics.chariot: Their chariot charges straight at you. At a fifth of its hull it breaks off and runs back under its banner to mend, then charges again once it has recovered - stay on it and finish it, do not let it run you twice.

equipment.weaponRack.name: Crossbow Rack
equipment.weaponRack.description: Improves crossbow damage and adds 1 arrow to each volley per upgrade; does not increase chariot collision damage.
equipment.horseArmor.name: Horse Armor
equipment.horseArmor.description: Improves protection, granting a chance to fully negate an incoming ranged attack.
equipment.shaftWheelRim.name: Shaft & Wheel Rim
equipment.shaftWheelRim.description: Improves mobility, speed, and steering; each level also adds 2 collision damage.
equipment.axleCap.name: Axle Cap
equipment.axleCap.description: Improves stability and increases maximum chariot health. Each level fits longer blades to the wheels; at max level a full-speed run fells a tree instead of costing hull points, leaving only a stump.
equipment.chariotBox.name: Chariot Box
equipment.chariotBox.description: Capacity is display-only; upgrades add slots for archers and halberdiers.
horse.description: Adds mobility and visible horses. Mobility affects speed and steering, not collision damage.
personnel.archer.name: Archer
personnel.archer.description: Automatically attacks at range; damage is independent of Firepower.
personnel.halberdier.name: Halberdier
personnel.halberdier.description: Automatically attacks in melee; damage is independent of Firepower.

namingStory.given.reason.hei: Your skin was dark at birth, so your father named you 黑.
namingStory.given.reason.bai: Your skin was fair at birth; when your grandmother saw you, she named you 白.
namingStory.given.reason.chi: Your face was flushed red at birth, so your father named you 赤 to remember the day.
namingStory.given.reason.chou: You were born looking unlike an ordinary baby, so the elders of the house named you 丑 and kept the story.
namingStory.given.reason.shi: You were born sturdy, and your grandfather hoped you would be as solid and tireless as stone, so he named you 石.
namingStory.given.reason.hu: On the night you were born the hunters of the house were talking of tigers in the hills, and your father named you 虎 for their fierceness.
namingStory.given.reason.bao: Your father had once seen a leopard in the hills and thought it swift and strong, so he named you 豹.
namingStory.given.reason.niu: Your family lived by farming, and your father hoped you would be as strong and tireless as an ox, so he named you 牛.
namingStory.given.reason.ma: A good horse had just been bought when you were born, and your grandfather named you 馬 to remember the household's good fortune.
namingStory.given.reason.ju: A mare in the household had just foaled when you were born, so your father named you 駒 to remember it.
namingStory.given.reason.jia: The family was mending armour when you were born, and your grandfather named you 甲 in the hope that you would one day carry the family's burdens.
namingStory.given.reason.ge: Your father had served with the army and an old dagger-axe still hung in the house, so he named you 戈 to remember the family's ties to arms.
namingStory.given.reason.gong: The men of your house often practised archery, and your father named you 弓 for the weapon they always kept at hand.
namingStory.given.reason.huo: Your father came back from a hunt with a good catch around the time you were born and took it as a sign, so he named you 獲.
namingStory.given.reason.liang: Your father hoped you would be measured in dealing with others and upright in what you did, so he named you 良.
namingStory.given.reason.shan: Your grandfather set great store by good deeds and hoped his descendants would deal generously with others, so he named you 善.
namingStory.given.reason.xin: Your father had once lost an important ally by breaking his word, so he named you 信 to remind you that a man stands on his promises.
namingStory.given.reason.zhi: Your father disliked flattery and wanted you to deal plainly with people, so he named you 直.
namingStory.given.reason.fang: Your grandfather taught his children by the rule and the square, and named you 方 in the hope that you would keep to a straight standard.
namingStory.given.reason.he: Before you were born the family had quarrelled over fields and property, and your father named you 和 in the hope that the household would live at peace.
namingStory.given.reason.ning: The fighting near your home had paused when you were born, and your grandfather named you 寧 so that the family might be safe in a troubled age.
namingStory.given.reason.an: Not long after you were born the family ended its wandering and settled at last, so your father named you 安 to remember it.
namingStory.given.reason.ping: Years of grievance within the family were settled when you were born, and your grandfather named you 平 in the hope that you would know little of conflict.
namingStory.given.reason.ji: The family's sacrifices went well around the time you were born, and the elders took it as a good omen, so they named you 吉.
namingStory.given.reason.qing: An elder came home, or the kin gathered, on the day you were born, and your father named you 慶 in his joy.
namingStory.given.reason.cheng: A matter the family had carried for years was finished just as you were born, and your grandfather named you 成 so that things would be seen through to their end.
namingStory.given.reason.li: Your father had left home young to make a living and only stood on his own after much hardship, so he named you 立 in the hope that you would stand on your own too.
namingStory.given.reason.sheng: Your father had risen from a low post in the family to a place of trust, and named you 升 in the hope that you would likewise rise.
namingStory.given.reason.jian: You were born in deep winter, and your grandfather named you 堅, saying that a family must hold firm to see out hard times.
namingStory.given.reason.zhuang: Your father hoped you would grow strong enough to carry the work and guard the household, so he named you 壯.
namingStory.given.reason.yong: Your father had once regretted shying from a duty, so he named you 勇 in the hope that you would face what fell to you.
namingStory.given.reason.wu: Your grandfather had served in the defence of a city, and named you 武 in the hope that you could protect the family.
namingStory.given.reason.dan: Day was breaking when you were born, and your father named you 旦 in the hope that hard times were passing.
namingStory.given.reason.chen: Your grandfather was setting down the household's affairs by the day and hour when you were born, so he named you 辰 to record the moment.
namingStory.given.reason.chu: You were the first boy born to the family in many years, and your father named you 初 for a new beginning.
namingStory.given.reason.ji2: You were the youngest of the brothers, so the elders named you 季 for your place among them.
namingStory.given.reason.zhong: You came in the middle of the brothers, and the elders named you 仲 for your place among them.
namingStory.given.reason.you: A friend had once helped your father in his youth, so he named you 友 in the hope that you would value friendship.
namingStory.given.reason.shun: The household's affairs ran smoothly around the time you were born, so your grandmother named you 順 in the hope that your life would meet few obstacles.
namingStory.given.reason.gu: The family had lost its home on the road, and your father named you 固 in the hope that the household would be secure from then on.
namingStory.given.reason.heitun: You were born with a dark blue-black birthmark on your haunch, and the elders named you for it.
namingStory.given.reason.wuji: Your father wanted you to stand your ground rather than flinch from what should be faced, so he named you 無忌.
namingStory.given.reason.zhong2: The elders thought you were solidly built and heavy of frame when you were born, so they named you 重 for the way you looked.
namingStory.given.reason.er: Your ears were remarkably prominent at birth, and the elders named you 耳 for them.
namingStory.given.reason.yi: Your family had moved to a frontier where different peoples met, and the elders named you 夷 to remember the move.
namingStory.given.reason.heitun2: The elders noticed a clear black birthmark on your haunch when you were born, and named you 黑臀.
namingStory.given.reason.heigong: One of your arms was a different colour from the rest when you were born, and your father named you 黑肱 so that people would know you at a glance.
namingStory.given.reason.shuniu: As a small child you always trailed after the cattle, and your grandfather laughingly named you 竪牛, as if you were a herd boy.
namingStory.given.reason.guyutu: The elders gave you a name in the old Chu manner, with a tiger in it, in the hope that you would be as strong as one.
namingStory.given.reason.wuzhi: You disliked arguing as a child, and your father said that great wisdom looks like foolishness, so he named you 無知 to spare you the world's quarrels.
namingStory.given.reason.chai: You were born in the season of scorpions, and your grandmother named you 蠆 in the hope that you would keep silent before an enemy and strike once.
namingStory.given.reason.xie: Your hands and feet lay unlike any ordinary child's when you were born, and the elders named you 奊, a rare old character.
namingStory.given.reason.choufu: Your looks were nothing remarkable, so your father named you 丑父, caring for courage and good faith rather than appearance.
namingStory.given.reason.yiya: Your sense of smell was keen as a child and you could tell one cut of meat from another, so your mother named you 易牙 in the hope that you would master a craft.
namingStory.given.reason.yurang: Your family wanted you to act with care and plan before you moved, so your grandfather named you 豫讓.
namingStory.given.reason.daozhi: You were bold and restless as a child, over walls and across ditches and gone without a trace, and the elders named you 盜跖 half in reproof and half in jest.
namingStory.given.reason.shijiao: The family was making sacrifice to the ancestors when you were born, and your father gave you an old character in the hope that you would remember the clan's roots.
namingStory.given.reason.ganying: You watched insects fly as a child and could bring down small things in the air with one arrow, so your father named you 甘蠅 in the hope that you would become a fine archer.
namingStory.given.reason.lunbian: You were born into a house of wheelwrights, and your grandfather named you 輪扁 for the family's trade in the hope that you would take it up.
namingStory.given.reason.gongchui: You liked shaping wood and making things from an early age, and the elders named you 工倕 for a master craftsman in the hope that you would surpass your elders.
namingStory.given.reason.shiyi: Your father was sorting old bamboo records and the family's history when you were born, so he named you 史佚 in the hope that you would remember clearly and judge well.
namingStory.given.reason.yihe: A physician was treating the villagers when you were born, and your mother named you 醫和 in the hope that you would live at peace and know how to heal.
namingStory.given.reason.wugao: The clan was making sacrifice when you were born, and the elders gave you a name tied to the old ways of the shaman, in the hope that you would honour the spirits and know the rites.
namingStory.given.reason.hun: The great rivers were in flood when you were born, and your grandfather named you 混 in the hope that you would be broad enough to hold many streams.
namingStory.given.reason.hun2: You were thick-set and plain-spoken from birth, and your father named you 渾 in the hope that you would keep your honest nature.
namingStory.given.reason.kun: The elders hoped you would carry on the clan and love your brothers, so they named you 昆.
